source: D1's whole-schema lock for the V5T tools: every part, all eight skills home (build_gbnf, v5-tags-lock.gbnf)
grammar:
root ::= calls | answer
calls ::= call ("
" call){0,5}
call ::= "<tool_call>
<function=set_color>
" set-color-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=set_shape>
" set-shape-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=set_face>
" set-face-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=rename>
" rename-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=resize>
" resize-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=scale>
" scale-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=set_legs>
" set-legs-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=morph>
" morph-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=reset>
" reset-args "</function>
</tool_call>" | "<tool_call>
<function=do>
" do-args "</function>
</tool_call>"
answer ::= [^<] [^<]*
set-color-part ::= "torso" | "head" | "neck" | "tail" | "legs" | "front_legs" | "back_legs" | "arms" | "wings" | "eyes" | "jaw" | "belly" | "plates" | "horns" | "spikes" | "decoration" | "all"
set-color-color ::= "red" | "orange" | "yellow" | "green" | "blue" | "purple" | "pink" | "white" | "black" | "gray" | "brown"
set-color-args ::= ("<parameter=part>
" set-color-part "
</parameter>
" "<parameter=color>
" set-color-color "
</parameter>
") | ("<parameter=color>
" set-color-color "
</parameter>
" "<parameter=part>
" set-color-part "
</parameter>
")
set-shape-part ::= "torso" | "head" | "neck" | "tail" | "legs" | "front_legs" | "back_legs" | "arms" | "wings" | "eyes" | "jaw" | "belly" | "plates" | "horns" | "spikes" | "decoration"
set-shape-shape ::= "boxy" | "round"
set-shape-args ::= ("<parameter=part>
" set-shape-part "
</parameter>
" "<parameter=shape>
" set-shape-shape "
</parameter>
") | ("<parameter=shape>
" set-shape-shape "
</parameter>
" "<parameter=part>
" set-shape-part "
</parameter>
")
set-face-face ::= "happy" | "sleepy" | "surprised" | "angry" | "cool" | "none"
set-face-args ::= ("<parameter=face>
" set-face-face "
</parameter>
")
rename-name ::= [^<
] [^<
]{0,23}
rename-args ::= ("<parameter=name>
" rename-name "
</parameter>
")
resize-part ::= "torso_length" | "torso_width" | "torso_height" | "leg_length" | "leg_thickness"
resize-factor ::= "0." [5-9] [0-9]? | "1" ("." [0-9] [0-9]?)? | "2" (".0" "0"?)?
resize-args ::= ("<parameter=part>
" resize-part "
</parameter>
" "<parameter=factor>
" resize-factor "
</parameter>
") | ("<parameter=factor>
" resize-factor "
</parameter>
" "<parameter=part>
" resize-part "
</parameter>
")
scale-factor ::= "0." [5-9] [0-9]? | "1" ("." [0-9] [0-9]?)? | "2" (".0" "0"?)?
scale-args ::= ("<parameter=factor>
" scale-factor "
</parameter>
")
set-legs-pairs ::= "2" | "3"
set-legs-args ::= ("<parameter=pairs>
" set-legs-pairs "
</parameter>
")
morph-preset ::= "dog" | "spider" | "giraffe" | "lizard" | "stubby" | "original"
morph-args ::= ("<parameter=preset>
" morph-preset "
</parameter>
")
reset-args ::= ""
do-skill ::= "walk" | "sprint" | "backwards" | "turn-left" | "turn-right" | "spin" | "wave" | "get-up"
do-args ::= ("<parameter=skill>
" do-skill "
</parameter>
")
